      Travel to Kenya

      Experience the Natural Beauty and Vibrant Culture of Kenya with Saudia Airlines

      Discover a land where the rhythm of nature meets the soul of East Africa. From the endless horizons of the savannah to the turquoise waters of the coast, Kenya invites you to step into a world of breathtaking wonder. Fly with Saudia to start your journey with warm hospitality and arrive ready to explore the heart of the wild.


      1. Feast On Authentic Nyama Choma

      Gather around a sizzling grill for Kenya's favorite social tradition. Savor tender, roasted goat meat or beef seasoned simply with salt and served with spicy kachumbari for a true taste of local life.


      2. Witness The Great Migration

      Experience nature’s most dramatic spectacle as millions of wildebeest and zebras thunder across the plains. This awe inspiring journey through the Maasai Mara is a bucket list event that defines the spirit of the wild.


      3. Master Traditional Swahili Cooking

      Join a coastal kitchen to learn the secrets of coconut milk and aromatic spices. Crafting the perfect biryani or pilau is a flavorful way to connect with centuries of maritime heritage.


      4. Float In A Hot Air Balloon

      Rise with the sun over the vast Maasai Mara. Gliding silently above the landscape offers a majestic perspective on the wildlife roaming below in the soft morning light.


      5. Engage With Maasai Culture

      Visit a traditional manyatta to meet the iconic Maasai people. Learn about their ancient customs, vibrant beadwork, and deep connection to the land that has sustained their community for generations.


      6. Explore Ancient Coastal History

      Wander through the narrow, winding alleys of Lamu Old Town or the ruins of Gede. These historic sites tell a fascinating story of trade and Swahili culture along the Indian Ocean.


      7. Hike Majestic Mountain Peaks

      Challenge yourself with a trek up Mount Kenya. Journey through diverse ecosystems, from lush forests to alpine moorlands, as you ascend toward the jagged summits of Africa’s second highest peak.


      8. Sail On A Traditional Dhow

      Catch the breeze on a hand carved wooden sailboat at sunset. Drifting along the coastline offers a peaceful escape and a timeless view of Kenya’s golden shores.


      9. Savor Fresh Highland Tea

      Visit the rolling green hills of Kericho to see where some of the world’s finest tea begins. Enjoy a refreshing cup while overlooking the vast, manicured estates that blanket the misty highlands.


      10. Dive Vibrant Coral Reefs

      Plunge into the clear waters of the Watamu Marine National Park. Discover a colorful underwater garden filled with tropical fish, sea turtles, and spectacular coral formations.

      Scroll to view more →

      Cities You Should Visit When Traveling to Kenya

      1. Nairobi

      Experience the pulse of Kenya in its vibrant capital, the only city in the world where a national park meets a modern skyline. Witness orphaned elephants at the David Sheldrick Wildlife Trust or feed giraffes at the Giraffe Center before diving into a world-class culinary scene. From boisterous markets to high-end galleries, Nairobi offers an unparalleled fusion of wild nature and urban energy.
